record.field: Lists the tasks of the BookAI Tools project, the catalogue of AI tools: id, name, stage, area, type, testers and the linked tool. Filter by stage (proposal, implemented, validated, rejected), by area or with mine to get only the tools where the user is a tester. Also counts the tasks by stage. Read only.

Card of a task of the BookAI Tools project: description, stage, area, testers, the description of the linked AI tool, its change requests (subtasks) and the last 10 messages and notes in plain text. Read only.

Asks for a new AI tool: creates a task in the stage Proposal of the BookAI Tools project with the question the tool should answer, an example and an area, and makes the user a follower. Needs a preview and a confirmation. Changes data only in that project.
Makes the user a tester of a task of the BookAI Tools project (I will test it). Needs a preview and a confirmation. Changes data only in that project.

Reports a change or a bug on a tool of the BookAI Tools project: posts an internal note on its task and creates a subtask Change in the stage Proposal. Needs a preview and a confirmation. Changes data only in that project.

Validates a tool after testing it: only a tester of the task (or an administrator) can move it to the stage Validated and post the notes of the test. Needs a preview and a confirmation. Changes data only in the BookAI Tools project.
